# Quaternius Medieval Village MegaKit - compact Standard selection

24 original FBX environment parts selected for Where the Light Remains.
Original source: https://quaternius.com/packs/medievalvillagemegakit.html
Original download: https://quaternius.itch.io/medieval-village-megakit
Author: Quaternius. License: CC0 1.0 Universal.
The exact creator License_Standard.txt is retained under the original archive path.

Plain plaster openings, wood decks and rails, stone stairs, door trim and a small
pitched tile roof match the Paper Theatre construction language. Retint the
existing slots and use the project paper surface; do not rebuild their shapes.
Stock textures are retained for selected material declarations, including the
creator's alternate Godot-Unity normal maps for the Blender-to-Unreal workflow.
The two metal ornament images are supplied by the creator in the glTF folder.
FBX material paths may need relinking after import.

The source files remain unmodified. All 24 FBXs passed a separate Blender
5.2.2 LTS background import with no unresolved referenced images after original
texture relinking. Six representative stock-material renders were inspected.
The facade carries visible timber bracing and the full roof is steep; review
these shapes, depth and placement against the shallow paper reference. Mesh
bounds may extend below or away from the (0,0,0) object origins. UE 4.27.2
import/render validation remains pending. SOURCE.json records measured import
bounds, material slots, hashes, roles and small permitted adjustments.
